name: create-experiment
description: Thin compatibility entrypoint for creating a new Harness FME experiment. Invokes manage-experiments' Create experiment flow directly - same scope, parent/environment resolution, hypothesis, metrics, treatments, window, and rule - and returns the created experiment id plus verification. Use when asked to create an experiment, set up an A/B test, or design a new experiment. Do NOT use for updating, pausing, resuming, completing, archiving, or deleting an experiment (manage-experiments), or for explaining results (review-experiment-results). Trigger phrases: create experiment, set up an A/B test, design an experiment, launch a test, new experiment for X.
